stories.title: A smaller model improves tool-use reliability
stories.summary: A new evaluation shows that careful tool interfaces can matter more than raw model size for agent reliability.

stories.title: Researchers propose a clearer standard for agent evaluations
stories.summary: The proposed standard separates planning ability, tool errors, and environmental failures instead of reporting one aggregate score.

stories.title: Open robotics dataset targets manipulation tasks
stories.summary: A newly released dataset provides demonstrations and evaluation tasks for robotic manipulation research.
